[[Srinivasa Ramanujan]] (1887 – 1920) is the [[eponym]] of all of the topics listed below.

==Mathematics==
*[[Brocard–Ramanujan Diophantine equation]]
*Dougall–Ramanujan identity<ref>{{cite web
 | title = Dougall-Ramanujan Identity
 | url = https://proofwiki.org/wiki/Dougall-Ramanujan_Identity
 | website = ProofWiki
 | access-date = 16 December 2024
}}</ref>
*[[Landau–Ramanujan constant]]
*[[Ramanujan's congruences]]
*[[Hardy–Ramanujan number]]
*[[Hardy–Ramanujan theorem]]
*[[Partition_function_(number_theory)#Approximation_formulas|Hardy–Ramanujan asymptotic formula]]
*[[Basic_hypergeometric_series#Ramanujan's_identity|Ramanujan identity]]
*[[Ramanujan machine]]
*[[Ramanujan–Nagell equation]]
*[[Ramanujan–Peterssen conjecture]]
*[[Ramanujan–Soldner constant]]
*[[Ramanujan summation]]
*[[Ramanujan theta function]]
*[[Ramanujan graph]]
*[[Ramanujan's tau function]]
*[[Ramanujan's ternary quadratic form]]
*[[Ramanujan prime]]
*[[Ramanujan's constant]]
*[[Ramanujan's lost notebook]]
*[[Ramanujan's master theorem]]
*[[Ramanujan's sum]]
*[[Rogers–Ramanujan identities]]
*[[Rogers–Ramanujan continued fraction]]
*[[Ramanujan–Sato series]]
*[[Magic Square#Variations of the magic square|Ramanujan magic square]]
